reasoning: This question asks about comparing daily average temperatures at Rouen Airport on two dates in late October and early November 2025. November 2 is 7 days after October 26. In the Northern Hemisphere, late October to early November shows a seasonal cooling trend as winter approaches. Historically, temperatures typically decline by 1-3°C over this week-long period.
